svg.title: Unlimited beep
svg.desc: A data 1 (Tukey beep), a data 0 (silence), two 1s in a row and a STOP followed by the next START, rendered by the Encoder at 6 bytes/s, 48 kHz.
svg.text: One beep: real Encoder audio at 6 bytes/s (T 16.667 ms, 1500 Hz)
Rendered by the Encoder at 48000 Hz; amplitude relative to the crest A; dashed: the Tukey envelope of spec 1.1.
each beep ends in its own slot
the same beeps: a window's edge
A beep is the carrier times a Tukey window (α 0.5): cosine ramps over the first and last quarter of the slot, flat between them.
Every beep is 0 at its slot's edges, so consecutive tones still show where each slot begins and ends; energy 0.6875 T·A²/2.
START, STOP and every 1 are the same beep; the carrier runs on through silent slots (one phase-continuous pitch, no reversal).
